LESSON: MY FAMILY FAMILY MEMBERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.4: My Family Family members

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on My Family Family members. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to know members of your family?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
3. explain why it is important to honour parents
4. respect family members for harmonious co- existence
5. identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused
6. appreciate the body as a temple of the Holy Spirit and live a holy life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MY FAMILY FAMILY MEMBERS
This lesson teaches My Family Family members for Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. explain why it is important to honour parents
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. respect family members for harmonious co- existence
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
6. appreciate the body as a temple of the Holy Spirit and live a holy life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe My Family Family members using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about My Family Family members above.
2. Explain My Family Family members to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand My Family Family members.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My Family Family members with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is My Family Family members important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to know members of your family?
2. Why are healthy family relationships important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
3. explain why it is important to honour parents
4. respect family members for harmonious co- existence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
